acceptance.content:

Dari reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be notified of any material changes via email or through a notice on the platform.

services.title: Services Provided
services.content:
Dari provides a real estate management and advertising platform that includes:
• Listing and managing properties for sale and rent
• Comprehensive admin dashboard
• Analytics and reporting tools
• User management and permissions
• Content management system

userObligations.title: User Obligations
userObligations.content:
Users agree to the following:
• Provide accurate and truthful information during registration
• Maintain the confidentiality of login credentials
• Not use the platform for illegal purposes
• Not attempt unauthorized access to platform systems
• Comply with all applicable local laws and regulations

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: At Dari, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data

collection.title: Data Collection
collection.content:
We collect the following data when you use the platform:
• Personal information: name, phone number, email
• Usage data: browsing history, user preferences
• Technical data: IP address, browser type, operating system
• Geolocation data (with your consent)

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.content:
We use your data for the following purposes:
• Providing and improving our services
• Personalizing user experience
• Sending important notifications and updates
• Analyzing usage patterns to improve the platform
• Complying with legal requirements

protection.title: Data Protection
protection.content:
We take strict security measures to protect your data, including:
• Data encryption during transit and storage
• Intrusion detection and monitoring systems
• Restricted access to personal data
• Regular security audits
• Routine backups

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.content:
We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share your data only in the following cases:
• With your explicit consent
• With trusted service providers who help us operate the platform
• When required by competent legal authorities
• To protect the rights of Dari and its users

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content:
We retain your personal data as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services.

You may request the deletion of your account and data at any time by contacting our support team.
